tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum sngags can bzhugs// ༄༅// badz+ra dhā ra badz+ra gar+bha dpal// badz+ra ḍā ka tse lu dus zhabs gnyis// dpe med bsrung ba legs pa'i sras dang ni// chos kyi 'byung gnas chos kyi bshes gnyen dang*// rnam par grags pa'i lha dang shākya shrī// bzang po'i zhabs dang chos rje chos kyi mgon// mtshungs med bla ma'i tshogs la bdag skyabs mchi// dus rnams kun tu byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnai rāt+ma hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbir+wa pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ kah+ṇa pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥḍā ma ru pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a ba dhū ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥg ya dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥl li ta badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+ya a gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrtā bh+wa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānan+da dhā dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ḍāk+ki nī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbir+wa pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥḍom+bi pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a la la badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥb na si pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgar+bha ri pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshrī pan+da pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdurdza ya tsan+d+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbī ra badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dwe ṣa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥli la badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+ya gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbi la s+ya badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm hā a naṃ ga badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+ma badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.in+d+ra bhū ti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlak+ṣ+mī pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkah+ṇa ba hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshrī dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥg ya dha ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra hūm̐/

oṃ āḥdwe ṣa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥli la badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+yā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥs ra ha pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnā gārdzun pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsha ba ri pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlū hi pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdā ri ka pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkurma pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshrī dz+wā la dha ra pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkṛṣ+ṇa tsar+ya pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu h+ya pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbi dza ya pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥti lo pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnā ro pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a bha kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥwā gī shwa ra pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā kū ṭa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+yā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra se na tsan+d+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsu bhū ti pā la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da gar+bha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā pā li ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshān+ti gar+bha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsha ku la na mi tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsu kha badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshrād+dha ka ra warma hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgu ṇa shī la hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānan+da gar+bha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+yā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānan+da dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra gar+bha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkā la tsa kra pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a nu pa ma rak+ṣi ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsā dha pu tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā ka ra hūm̐/

oṃ āḥdharma mi tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbik+ṣa ta de wa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshākya shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥ.ā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnā gārdzu na hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ār+ya de wa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshākya mi tra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥtsan+d+ra kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥli la badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbha bya kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra bha ka ra kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra bha ka ra de wa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā ka ra shān+ti ba hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbik+ṣa ta de ba hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshākya shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharma swa myā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥl li ta badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a mo gha badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdz+nyā na ā ka ra gup+ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+ma badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdī paṃ ka ra rak+ṣi ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdz+nyā na si dha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥl k+ṣaṃ siṃ ha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.i shwa ra kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ya mā ri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// //oṃ āḥshākya mu ni hūm̐/ oṃ āḥmañju gho ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.a shwa ka shrī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+rā sa na pā da hūm̐/ oṃ āḥrat+na kīrti hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.ānan+da gar+bha hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpuṇ+yā gra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharma swa myā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhā ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥlo ke shwa ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsha wa ri pa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥme trī gu h+ya hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshākya rak+ṣi ta hūm̐/ oṃ āḥka na ka shrī hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdza ya se na hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā gu ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ āḥkīrti dh+wa dza hūm̐/ oṃ āḥdharmā swa myā nan+da dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐/
oṃ āḥm ti dh+wa dza shrī bha dra hūm̐// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
